title: Recent trends in ionic liquid-mediated synthesis of thiazoles: toward greener methodologies
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,40912-40966
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05665A, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Shital Mohurle, Barnali Maiti
This review provides a structured overview of ionic liquids in the green synthesis of thiazoles, emphasizing their roles, comparing them with other sustainable media, and highlighting future directions for eco-friendly heterocyclic chemistry.
